summary: This Form 8-K reports a routine monthly issuance of 195,291.294 Class I shares at roughly $25.06 per share for aggregate proceeds of $4.894 million under KKR FS Income Trust Select's continuous private offering. The offering relies on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D for accredited investors, with no board recommendation or advisor cited. The company has issued ~39.8 million shares totaling $1.013 billion toward a $5.0 billion target. This is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation. Status: no risk-arb angle; continued monthly sales expected until the cap is reached.
